storage.full_scale_declared: 6 TB scratch, 30 TB retained products; not provisioned
storage.downselect_declared: less than 1 MB inputs and artifacts

platform.downselect: contemporary Python 3, no scheduler or accelerator

operator_support.full_scale: scheduler, storage, failed-job recovery, and export review

monetary_allocative_cost.full_scale_declared: allocation required; monetary equivalent not asserted

freshness.on_failure: append stale or reproduction-failed event; do not overwrite prior evidence

non_substitutability: The ten axes are descriptive and not reducible to a scalar; expert judgment, restricted access, storage, and GPU-hours are not interchangeable.
